svg.aria-label: pipekit-array's areas and their imports: bridges imports kernels and named, operators imports named, kernels imports named and arrays, and named and arrays import no other area; testing, beside the package, imports named and kernels. Every area imports pipekit-ops; the other libraries come through extras, but for array_api_strict, a test reference.
